name: Morak
description: Morak was a jungle planet located in Wild Space on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories inhabited by humans as well as members of the Shydopp species. The planet served as a secret mining hub for the Galactic Empire, which processed rhydonium in a secret refinery, which was tightly guarded by shoretroopers and stormtroopers.
